Home.title: Meet HR Platform
Home.subtitle: High-performance serverless infrastructure for intensive workloads.
Home.heading: Building the future of AI infrastructure.
Home.p1: HR Platform is a global, high-performance serverless platform for running AI applications across CPUs, GPUs, and accelerators.
Home.p2: The rise of Generative AI and agentic workloads redefined cloud infrastructure with a dramatic increase in scale and a set of new requirements. To support these workloads, we provide serverless GPUs, specialized accelerators, and CPU workloads with capabilities to increase efficiency, enable new use-cases and control costs.

Footer.description: Build the serverless platform for modern AI and HR operations.
